target.title: fix(codex): resolve dynamic tool hard timeout from timeoutSeconds when timeoutMs is absent
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a dynamic tool call passes `timeoutSeconds` (e.g. `{ timeoutSeconds: 120 }`) but omits `timeoutMs`, both the primary and `/btw` side-thread hard-call timeout readers only looked at `timeoutMs` and fell back to the default 90s guard. Tools that explicitly set a longer timeout in seconds (e.g. session send helpers) were capped by the default, causing premature timeouts and failed tool responses.

Fixes [#98864](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98864).

## Why This Change Was Made

Both the primary (`dynamic-tool-execution.ts`) and side-thread (`side-question.ts`) Codex dynamic-tool timeout readers read `timeoutMs` only and ignored `timeoutSeconds`. The fix applies the existing `readTimeoutSecondsAsMs` helper as a fallback when `timeoutMs` is absent or invalid — the same pattern already used for config-level image tool timeouts on both paths.

### Behavior rules

| Priority | Input | Outcome |
|----------|-------|---------|
| 1 | `timeoutMs` is valid positive number | Use `timeoutMs` (existing behavior) |
| 2 | `timeoutMs` absent/invalid, `timeoutSeconds` valid | Use `timeoutSeconds * 1000` (**new**) |
| 3 | Both absent/invalid | Fall back to configured or default timeout (existing) |

## User Impact

- **Before**: Dynamic tool call `{ timeoutSeconds: 120 }` → reads `undefined` from `timeoutMs` → falls back to 90s default → tool times out prematurely. Affected both primary and `/btw` side-thread calls.
- **After**: Dynamic tool call `{ timeoutSeconds: 120 }` → reads `120000` from `timeoutSeconds` fallback → tool gets the full 120s. Consistent across both paths.

`timeoutMs` always wins when both are present; `timeoutSeconds` is a pure fallback. No existing callers are affected.

## Evidence

### Unit Tests (58/58 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-execution.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  58 passed (58)
```

Primary path: +3 tests (timeoutSeconds fallback, timeoutMs precedence, invalid value)
Side-thread path: +2 tests (timeoutSeconds fallback, timeoutMs precedence)

### Real Machine Runtime Verification

**Environment**: Linux x64, Node v24.18.0

```
=== 修改前 (314c53b814) ===
Case 1 - timeoutSeconds=120, 无 timeoutMs → 90000  ❌ 忽略 timeoutSeconds
Case 5 - timeoutMs="bad" + timeoutSeconds=60   → 90000  ❌ 忽略 timeoutSeconds

=== 修改后 (c5f8f79b82) ===
Case 1 - timeoutSeconds=120, 无 timeoutMs → 120000 ✅ timeoutSeconds 生效
Case 2 - timeoutMs=30000 + timeoutSeconds=120 → 30000  ✅ timeoutMs 优先
Case 3 - 无 timeoutMs 无 timeoutSeconds → 90000       ✅ 默认值不变
Case 4 - timeoutSeconds="bad" → 90000                ✅ 无效值忽略
Case 5 - timeoutMs="bad" + timeoutSeconds=60 → 60000  ✅ timeoutSeconds 回退
```

### Verification Summary

| Scenario | Primary | Side-thread |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `timeoutSeconds=120`, no `timeoutMs` | ✅ 120000 | ✅ 120000 |
| `timeoutMs=30000` + `timeoutSeconds=120` | ✅ 30000 (timeoutMs wins) | ✅ 30000 (timeoutMs wins) |
| Neither field | ✅ Default | ✅ Default |
| Invalid `timeoutSeconds="bad"` | ✅ Default | ✅ Default |

## Changes

| File | Changed | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| `extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-execution.ts` | 1 line | `readDynamicToolCallTimeoutMs`: add `?? readTimeoutSecondsAsMs(value.timeoutSeconds)` |
| `extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.ts` | 1 line | `readSideDynamicToolCallTimeoutMs`: add `?? readSideTimeoutSecondsAsMs(value.timeoutSeconds)` |
| `extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-execution.test.ts` | +3 tests | timeoutSeconds fallback, timeoutMs precedence, invalid value |
| `extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.test.ts` | +2 tests | timeoutSeconds fallback, timeoutMs precedence |

Both paths use the same `readTimeoutSecondsAsMs` / `readSideTimeoutSecondsAsMs` helpers that already existed for config-level image tool timeout resolution. No new helpers added.
